sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Elegant Lavender Glass Bangle Set with Golden Ghoonghroo Accents – 16-Piece
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add a touch of lavender grace with this set of 12 glass bangles paired with 4 golden ghoonghroo bangles. This fashionable ensemble offers a melodic charm to your ethnic look. To preserve the brilliant golden luster of the charms, keep them away from moisture and store safely after use.
To ensure safe delivery, prepaid payment is mandatory as this is a fragile item
